messages:
maria_cs: Quick weekly cohort health check — short version: streaming p95 mostly steady (~120ms), but streaming p99 spiked to ~1.1s for /generate on redwood-7B-q4 yesterday. Non-streaming p99 stayed ~900ms. Usage for Onboard Cohort 7 jumped +42% WoW, spend +8% WoW. Sharing the short stats and suggested next steps below.

kevin_eng: can you paste the per-route numbers? especially by model and streaming vs non-streaming.

maria_cs: sure — pulled from telemetry window Mon 00:00 -> Sun 23:59 (UTC). raw lines: 
```
/complete  | redwood-7B-q4 | streaming   | p95=118ms  p99=370ms  errors=0.2%
/complete  | redwood-7B-q4 | non-stream  | p95=160ms  p99=890ms  errors=0.3%
/generate  | redwood-7B-q4 | streaming   | p95=125ms  p99=1100ms errors=0.9%  (spike window 09:10-09:40 UTC)
/generate  | redwood-7B-q4 | non-stream  | p95=210ms  p99=920ms  errors=0.4%
/rerank    | llama-13B     | streaming   | p95=95ms   p99=400ms  errors=0.6%
/rerank    | llama-13B     | non-stream  | p95=130ms  p99=450ms  errors=0.7%
```
(more granular payload sizes attached in the deck)

sam_research: that /generate streaming p99 jump — any correlating deploy or rollout?

ops-bot: Alert: high-p99-detection — /generate streaming (redwood-7B-q4) exceeded 1.0s for 30m at 2026-03-18T09:12Z — automatic sample capture available.

kevin_eng: I checked deploy logs — no model rollout during spike window. There was a transient host OOM in dedicated pool dp-7 around 09:08 but autoscaled and recovered. KV-cache miss rate for that pool increased ~3.2x in the same window.

maria_cs: interesting — cohort 7 traffic routes primarily to dp-7 (dedicated). Could be hot shard + cold cache combo.

olivia_pm: any customer impact? Renewal conversations?

maria_cs: most accounts in cohort are still green on SLAs; however Maple (onboarding) saw a 3% drop in successful completions during the spike window — product team flagged as potential friction point. Renewal risk for Maple moved from none -> low-medium; CS owner assigned.

nate_support: I pinged Maple's PO and scheduled an enablement call for Tue. Also collected a sample event from the alert.

sam_research: short mitigation ideas: 1) enable stronger prefix caching for /generate for that cohort, 2) temporarily route cohort traffic to a compatible quantized variant (redwood-7B-q4-compat) that has been stable, 3) investigate kv cache warmup policy on dp-7.

kevin_eng: agree. immediate action: add a canary route to redirect 10% of cohort 7 /generate to the compat variant for 4 hours and monitor p99. ops will also clear some cold shards to encourage cache warmup.

maria_cs: AIs for this week: 
- @kevin_eng: add 10% canary to compat variant and post results (due: today EOD)
- @sam_research: run a short synthetic replay of cohort traffic against dp-7 and compat variant (due: tomorrow morning)
- @nate_support: follow up with Maple and capture any UX repro steps (due: Tue before call)

olivia_pm: please note in renewal tracker: Maple = low-med risk; follow-up scheduled.

kevin_eng: started canary now — will update when we have 30m of data. initial traces show <5% errors on canary, p99 ~420ms for compat variant.

maria_cs: thanks — I'll update weekly deck and notify CS leads. if p99 on primary route stabilizes after cache warmup, we'll close the alert.

ops-bot: Canary started: cohort7 -> redwood-7B-q4-compat (10%) at 2026-03-18T16:04Z.

kevin_eng: quick note — unrelated: rerank streaming p95 improved after batch size bump last week, continue monitoring.

maria_cs: wrap-up: overall cohort health still positive, single streaming p99 incident tied to dp-7 cache behavior. actions assigned and Maple follow-up scheduled. tagging this thread for weekly audit. :white_check_mark:
